rules.reason: one driver is moved at a time with the others at base (a tornado layout); the repo's risk_tornado calculator documents the same convention
rules.gap: the cited tornado literature (Eschenbach 1992) is paywalled and was not opened; WIPO supports only that a single scenario limits the assessment (VP-V-011)

rules.reason: drivers are ranked by absolute swing (rank-by-consequence)
rules.gap: no source prescribes the ranking metric; a swing depends on the scales the team chose

rules.reason: the switching value is the scale of one driver at which the base rNPV equals a team-named threshold (bisection)
the scales are supplied by the team; the script ships no default percentage
rules.gap: the repo calculator defaults to plus or minus 20 percent; no registered source supports that default, so none is used here

rules.passage: Relying solely on one scenario may limit the assessment to a single set of outcomes.

rules.reason: owner ruling V5: the adopted valuation and the choice of rate are human only
